footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Graham Holdings: after $11.0M attributable to noncontrolling interests, $1.6M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 2.5% to $4.9B in 2025. Gross margin was 29.9%, versus 30.6% a year earlier, and operating income rose 9.0% to $235M, a 4.8% margin.
Net income fell 59.6% to $291M, or $66.47 per share. Operating cash flow was $347M and free cash flow $275M, versus $324M; Graham Holdings returned $3.5M through buybacks.
sources: Graham Holdings Company Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
